entities.summary: Theodore I of Corsica, born Freiherr Theodor Stephan von Neuhoff, was a German adventurer who was briefly King of Corsica. Theodore is the subject of an opera by Giovanni Paisiello, Il re Teodoro in Venezia, and one of the six kings in Venice in Voltaire's Candide.
